content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of purchase invoices.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to purchase invoices.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for purchase invoices.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of purchase invoices. You can include remittance instructions, payment details, or any other relevant information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing purchase invoices using this footer will not be affected.
